summary: Read back the installed daily iOS build before installation, and support explicit version-floor reconciliation for builds installed outside the updater.

compatibility.detail: Approved delivery refuses artifacts at or below the installed-build floor. Missing bundles, unreadable device queries and malformed versions defer installation instead of assuming it is safe.

downtime.detail: No live device or scheduler change.

manual.detail: After repinning the updater, the operator runs the configured command once with --reconcile-installed before resuming scheduled delivery. This read-only device query raises the stored version floor without deployment approval, building, installing or launching.

recovery.detail: Interrupted-install recovery and explicit reconciliation share one readback path. Contradictory successful observations clear stale installed-content identity without lowering the authoritative version floor.
